module_summary: AXI4-Lite slave exposing four 32-bit registers: write channels accepted together (optionally via skid buffers) update a strobe-merged register, reads mux a register into a registered RDATA.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid; with WVALID triggers write acceptance.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address/data ready driven by single-cycle awready pulse.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid, required with AWVALID to accept a write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write address; word bits select which register is written.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data merged by strobes into the selected register.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid set on accepted write, cleared by BREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid; starts a read when ready.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready whenever no read response is pending.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read address; word bits select the register returned.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid from read-valid register; gates read data update.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Registered read data from the address-selected register.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: Write-commit strobe: updates registers and raises BVALID.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Word index selecting the register to write.

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Word index selecting the register for read data.

anchors.name: r0
anchors.why: Software-writable register (one of four r0-r3) read back over AXI.

anchors.name: wskd_r0
anchors.why: Byte-strobe merge of write data with old register value.

groups.name: Write channel control
groups.description: Accepts AW/W together, issues write strobe and B response.

groups.name: Register bank
groups.description: Four 32-bit registers updated with strobe-merged write data.

groups.name: Read channel
groups.description: Accepts read address, muxes selected register into registered RDATA.
